title: Simultaneous normalized scalar section comparisons
statement: For a morphism φ of commutative condensed rings, let b be a family of universally normalized derived scalar/pullback comparisons. There is one section scalar comparison s at each scheme, normalized on ordinary balanced generators and flat-term K-flat computation counits, such that every b_h is SectionPullNormalized relative to s at its endpoints. The derived categories are ordinary unbounded internal and section module categories. See [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons], [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data] for the exact fixed operations and normalization equations.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 0D6D, 07A7 and 0E47; scalar exchange rectangle proof steps 1 and 6

proof.text: Apply internal_scalar_pullback_normalization to the identity at each scheme and retain its normalized section scalar comparison. Choose these comparisons pointwise. For every edge apply the endpoint normalization transport theorem to the two chosen normalized comparisons and the supplied PullNormalized witness. These supply the simultaneous family and every required section pullback normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_scalar_section_family (φ : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom φ]
    (b : ∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ V),
      D φ V ⋙ L Λ' h ≅ L Λ h ⋙ D φ U)
    (normalized : ∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ V), PullNormalized φ h (b h)) :
    ∃ s : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, SectionScalarComparison φ T,
      (∀ T : Scheme.{u}, SectionScalarNormalized φ T (s T)) ∧
      ∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ V),
        SectionPullNormalized φ h (s U) (s V) (b h)
